title: Business Development Strategies - Liberia news The New Dawn Liberia, premier resource for latest news

facts.fact: The Business Development Strategies article was published on April 17, 2011.
The article's author states that in the UK more than 80% of businesses are small and medium scale oriented, as an example of European economies being driven by SMEs.
facts.quote: In UK for example,-more than 80% of businesses are small and medium scale oriented.

facts.fact: The newspaper's business guide column was launched as its 1st edition, with the author intending to run it every Monday.
facts.quote: For this I wish to have you on board every Monday of the week.
